# A file holding nothing but two prices and the commodity one of them needs.
#
# The NASDAQ:AMZN price states its guid and a full UTC time, as `export` writes
# a price. The USD rate states neither a guid nor a time of day: `time:` is a
# bare date and `value:` a decimal, as a price is typed by hand.
#
# What this fixture produces: a book holding two prices, AMZN in USD at
# 2026-01-06 21:00:00 UTC and USD in CAD on 2026-01-02 at GnuCash's time for a
# date.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_file_of_prices_imports_on_its_own.py.
2026-01-01 commodity AMZN
	mnemonic: "AMZN"
	fullname: "Amazon.com Inc"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000

price
	guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	time: "2026-01-06 21:00:00 +0000"
	value: "21845/100"
	source: "Finance::Quote"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-02"
	value: "1.3642"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"
